text: Entry 1383 restores all three changed files byte-for-byte to the first parent of 1380. Entry 1384 then reapplies the clang update under a different bug/review. The original Linux task incorrectly fetched win64-clang-19-raw; the corrected task fetches linux64-clang-19-raw. This is an exact source-chain finding. The backout message says it fixes mistakes, but source alone does not prove that mismatch caused a particular CI failure or that it was the only reason. No test, build or runtime operation was run. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion is pending; source landing alone does not establish reviewer approval.
title: The first clang 19 landing was fully undone before a corrected reapplication
